description:
This video explains how renewable energy credits (RECs) work, their role in grid integration, and who benefits and pays. It discusses compliance and voluntary REC markets, physical grid realities, and challenges in evaluating green energy claims.

Report sources:
https://www.epa.gov/green-power-markets/retail-recs
https://www.epa.gov/green-power-markets/energy-attribute-tracking-systems
https://www.ftc.gov/business-guidance/resources/environmental-claims-summary-green-guides
thumbnailPrompt: A vivid illustration of a wind turbine and solar panels in the background with a grid or transmission lines in the foreground, symbolizing the integration of renewable energy sources into the power grid.
title: The Truth About Renewable Energy Credits
